recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, shallow-depth-of-field portrait of a man in a dark blazer, positioned off-center against a bright, blurred industrial background, topped with widely spaced, elegant serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the dark blazer and the overexposed, bright background
Alignment of the subject's gaze with the viewer
Extreme horizontal tracking in the typography balancing the verticality of the subject
Color coordination between the subject's eyes and the primary text color
coreInvariants: High-key lighting with blown-out highlights in the background
Wide letter spacing (tracking) for all text elements
Subject positioned in the right third of the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium close-up, positioned on the right side of the frame, occupying approximately 40% of the width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left text, move across to the top-right text, then drop down to the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space on the left side, filled with a blurred, bright industrial environment.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Bright white and pale beige (background and highlights)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted teal-blue (primary text and eye color)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value (brightness) in the background and low value in the subject's clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earth tones and cool neutrals

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical Roman Serif and Geometric Sans-Serif
letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes in the serif font
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard glyphs used with modified spacing

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the brightest part of the background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Classic serif for the name paired with a modern, light sans-serif for the title to create a timeless yet contemporary feel.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment across the top margin

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high-contrast serif elegance for the display text.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Futura Light or Gill Sans Light
candidateDirections.reason: Offers the clean, geometric sans-serif look for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key portrait of a man with short hair wearing a black blazer. He is positioned on the right side of the frame, looking directly at the camera. The background is a bright, overexposed industrial setting with concrete and metal, heavily blurred using a shallow depth of field. The lighting should be soft and diffused from the front-left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text. The top line should be a high-contrast serif in all caps, spanning the width of the image with extreme tracking, using a teal color for the first half and black for the second. The second line should be a light geometric sans-serif in all caps, positioned in the upper left negative space with wide tracking in black.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking wide enough to feel airy?
Is the background sufficiently overexposed to create a white-out effect at the top?
Does the teal text color match the subject's eye color?
Is the subject correctly placed on the right third?

adjustableVariables: Amount of negative space on the left
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or logos
Ensure the background is not a recognizable specific location

mustAchieve: High-key lighting without losing facial detail

postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility against the bright background
Ensure the skin tones remain natural despite high-key lighting
Verify the horizontal alignment of the top text row
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key, off-center portrait with widely tracked, mixed-font all-caps typography at the top margin.
